rules_applied.clock: time_s = (frame - 1) / 100; source rate kept; no resampling. One clock per table (as GT21 uses one 200 Hz clock): plate force and CoP are the 1 kHz plate samples that coincide with the frames (index 10 x frame), no averaging, no interpolation; the plate samples between frames are not in the table.
rules_applied.angles_velocity_power: S02 v7 per-leg side-view plane geometry frame by frame; hip = thigh - pelvis, knee = thigh - shank, ankle = foot - shank; velocity = numpy.gradient(angle, 0.01, edge_order=1) (T04 method on the source clock); power = moment x joint speed, missing where either is missing.
rules_applied.pelvis_and_knee_markers: pelvis = Vicon tilt with the audited sign (-1; AB04/i0 +1 by D-UM21-P01-1 = C), one column from the right-side channel; frames of strides whose pelvis/hip/moment the v4 phase table holds are missing in the time table; knee marker names reversed (KNEM lateral) as in S02 and checked per leg.
rules_applied.plane_glitch: rule P1 applied per frame (leg plane > 60 degrees from the walking direction): leg-plane columns missing at that frame.
rules_applied.force: plate force (N; README N/kg is contradicted by UM21-SLOPE) turned with the S02 registration (axis, sign, belt tilt), negated, divided by body mass x 9.81 (mass from ParticipantDetails, never invented); vertical up, anterior walking direction, lateral outward per leg. < 20 N on a finite plate sample = 0 BW; non-finite plate sample = missing. Held for a leg (all missing, reason in held_signals) when registration unknown, mass missing, plate loaded at < 95 percent of that leg's heel strikes (S02 gate item), or recording pending by ruling.
rules_applied.cop: S02 rule per frame with the S02 fitted shift; published only where the S02 gate passed and the recording is not pending by ruling; unloaded < 20 N missing, never 0. Held list unchanged: AB01/i10, AB02/i10, AB03/i10, AB04/d10, AB10/d5.
rules_applied.assessment: L2 (30 degrees between adjacent 100 Hz samples, finite samples only) is the only limit on the time table; L1 and L5 stay on the phase table; all other time columns 'unchecked'; missing/held = unchecked_all_missing. Phase statuses are NOT changed (v4 phase L2 already runs on the 100 Hz frames); agreement with the v3 phase L2 failures is reported as evidence.

logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.question: Phase table gets no force columns

logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.why: their plate registration was never investigated; nothing is invented

logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.question: Force publication gate
logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.chosen: registration known AND mass known AND plate loaded at >= 95 percent of the leg's heel strikes (existing S02 item); the other-plate fraction is stored, not gated

logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.question: Time observation with an L2 jump
logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.chosen: failed in full, absent from filtered (observation is the unit; GT21/GT23 precedent), listed in exclusions.csv
logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.why: same rule as every other observation; rate is unknown until the pilot, reported in time_assessment.json

logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.question: Time-table pelvis
logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.chosen: single Vicon column (right-side channel); right-left difference recorded per recording and any difference shows in readback R4
logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.why: mirrors the phase table's pelvis; no new estimate

logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.question: Velocity and power tolerance in the readback
logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.chosen: velocity NRMS <= 0.03 per stride in >= 99 percent of strides; power reported, not gated
logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.why: written before any result; derived on different clocks so equality is not expected

logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.question: No stance flag independent of the plate
logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.chosen: a finite plate sample < 20 N is 0 BW (foot off its own belt plate); GT21's 'stance but unloaded = missing' cannot be reproduced without an independent stance event
logged_decisions_conservative_option_cho.why: each belt plate is that foot's own; accepted convention of 0 when off the plate

open_risks: Tests were not run and no code was executed: expect fixes at first run (imports, schema, builder interplay with the new time parts).

Clock: the time clock (frame - 1) / 100 is assumed to equal the v2 stride clock (source_start_time_s = (a - 1) / 100). Readback R6 checks it; if v2 used another convention the time table or the check must follow the v2 definition.

AB04/i0 pelvis sign is +1 by composing the audited -1 with the P01 correction -1; the pilot's R4 pelvis comparison (AB04/i0 is in the pilot set) confirms or refutes it. Time pelvis is the right-side Vicon channel; any right/left difference is recorded and would surface in R4 for left strides.
Time-table frames outside every stride window are not checked against the markers for the pelvis (no phase evidence exists there).

A foot on the wrong belt would give 0 BW on its own plate for up to 5 percent of heel strikes the S02 gate tolerates; the other-plate fraction is stored in time_summary.json registrations but not gated (T05-C).
AB03 and AB10 plates carry 3 to 9 percent less than body weight (UM21-SLOPE); their force is published as recorded and the limitation text says so.

A time observation is a whole recording: one L2 jump removes it from the filtered time table. The rate is unknown until the pilot; time Vicon pelvis jumps can differ from the v3 marker-pelvis L2 (agreement table reports them).

Velocity and power in the time table and the phase table are derived on different clocks, so they agree only to finite-difference error (NRMS tolerance stated); this is documented in README, not hidden.
